parts:
You can always set your own limits and labels, but I'm not sure if there is an option for this or not.  

On Mon, Oct 8, 2012 at 3:51 AM, Tom Hiatt <tomh...@gmail.com> wrote:
I've noticed that the data presented in a ggplot scatterplot often exceeds the maximum label on the X or Y scale. See the geom_point() example where the data for wt exceeds the min and max labels on the x-axis (2 and 5). Is there anyway to control this so all data values are within the min and max axis label? This can be seen in the same example on the y-axis where all the points for mpg fall within 10 and 35 - the min and max of the y-axis.
